standfirst: Porcine teschovirus is a single-genus module: a short leader, the four-capsid-protein layout, a 2A StopGo peptide of about 20 residues and a single VPg. BV-BRC annotates the genus densely, so every feature was built at the documented defaults.

modules.Teschovirus: L+, VP4-VP2-VP3-VP1, 2A StopGo, one VPg. POLY is the only feature with copy_num; the thirteen mature peptides are derived from it.

gaps: No feature lacks a collection. The leader comes in two annotated lengths: 86 residues, and 118 residues when an upstream in-frame AUG is used. The module models the 86-residue form, which every 118-residue record contains.
derived: All mature peptides are cleavage products of POLY, with both extensions set to 0.
